notes.title: Locomotion Update
notes.content:
Hi,

We have updated the locomotion system so that it now contains a strafe mechanic. 

After receiving many suggestions to implement this, we have done so. 

In addition to moving forward and backwards, you can now use the touch pad to strafe left and right. Let us know if this improves the current movement mechanics.

We are also currently implementing the teleport mechanic since some people prefer this way of movement. This will be coming soon, please be patient and check back for more information regrading this as it develops.

Any further questions, please feel free to email info@deceptive-games.com or post in the discussion forums.

Many thanks

Deceptive Games
